description.content: Submit a document (receipt, invoice, bill, or other financial document) for AI-powered OCR extraction. Returns structured JSON with vendor details, line items, taxes, totals, and other captured fields. Supports file uploads, URLs, base64-encoded data, and S3 references. Optionally supports asynchronous processing via webhooks.

The Veryfi OCR API extracts structured data from financial documents including receipts, invoices, bank statements, checks, W-2s, W-8s, W-9s, business cards, contracts, and more. The API uses AI-powered OCR to capture line items, taxes, totals, barcodes, vendor details, and other financial data across 91 currencies and 38 languages with enterprise-grade accuracy.
